'''Pavil Geraneos''' is a jewel merchant from [[Illian]].

==Appearance==
Pavil is a young man with dark eyes and a clean shaven face.

==Activities==
Pavil and [[Jeorg Damentanis]] negotiate with [[Weilin Aldragoran]] to purchase gems. They were at an inn called [[The Queen's Lance]] in [[Kayacun]], a city in [[Saldaea]].
